It identifies this as a one-way equation with propagation speed −c and gives the printed solution family q²(x,t)=q̃(x+ct), describing leftward acoustic travel at the speed of sound (printed page 2, equation (1.5), mode definitions, and final paragraph). The notation change from w² to q², admissible profile regularity, and exact material-parameter domain are not explicitly resolved.
